identity.vehicle_identity_reference: The exact source, vehicle, VIN, car, installation and lineage tuple stored in the owner-only binding with the preceding digest; raw values are not copied into this receipt.

producer.created_at_rule: After a matching coordinator authorization receipt exists, the immutable wrapper reads CLOCK_REALTIME once immediately before claiming the invocation guard, records that Unix-millisecond value in the guard, and passes the same value unchanged to the helper.

one_call_guard.enforcement: The wrapper requires an exact authorization object for this binding, transaction and one-call/no-retry policy. It then creates the guard with O_CREAT|O_EXCL before spawning. Any later invocation fails at the existing guard. Timeout or nonzero exit is final and cannot be retried.

direct_baseline.applications_and_sequence_counts: Not exposed by the Hub status/doctor interface. A separate read-only sqlite3 process was denied with SQLite error 14, so no zero count is inferred for those private tables.

post_event_acceptance.receiver: The one helper call exits successfully after one matching receiver ACK.
post_event_acceptance.edge: Exactly one admission is observed, no rejection or gap appears, and after Hub ACK the v2 pull is empty and spool records/bytes return to zero.
post_event_acceptance.hub: The sealed lineage is durably committed before ACK; every observed sequence is disposition-classified; pending publications return to zero; ACK frontier advances from null; exactly one VehicleName projection appears with no numeric, unit-bearing, lifecycle or passive-source projection.
post_event_acceptance.ambiguity: Any timeout, nonzero producer result, unknown sequence, gap, duplicate projection, nonempty pending state or unverifiable durable state fails closed without a producer retry.

cleanup.requirements: Record exact PID and exit result, close 18523/21444/21445/21843/8080, verify the shared build lock is absent, and retain the versioned roots as non-reusable redacted evidence.

limitations: Candidate-process evidence only; no installed, package, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance is claimed.
